snippet.title: BoomER Ville Land - UBI Denied: Corporate Tax Incentives & H1B Visas (Action B17)
snippet.description:
Your UBI was reallocated as a tax incentive for corporations to 'create jobs'... so they hired H1B visa holders instead. No payment, but inflation still increases! 📉💸
